title: The MCE codec declares each namespace once, the processed worksheet falls from 3,540,261 to 194,508 bytes, and the slicing consumers re-declare at the slice boundary
decision: retained, implemented in litchi-ooxml-common, litchi-docx, litchi-pptx and litchi-xlsx
authority: decision 1 of change 0652: "MCE namespace re-declaration: accept the public API changes."
code_state: crates/litchi-ooxml-common (the writer, a new mce::fragment module, two additions to the hidden private namespace), crates/litchi-docx, crates/litchi-pptx and crates/litchi-xlsx consumer sites named by change 0588; no signature, type, error or limit changed; every public change is additive or documentation; no new unsafe and no new dependency
reason_codes: change 0588 implemented this design, measured it at -80% of the codec and -85% of a real-file open plus cell, and withdrew it because the slice consumers depended on the writer's redundancy and two writers publish its bytes; change 0652 decision 1 authorizes both halves

change 0649 attributed 93.9% of a 133.61 ms real-deck opened-transaction edit to this one mechanism -- six whole-slide rewrites per edit, each amplified 16.25x -- and this removes 81.0% of that edit on the same deck through two independent instruments

the corpus differential is the oracle: 6,964 real fixture parts, a namespace-resolving projection identical on every one, every Report counter identical, every borrow decision identical, every refusal identical, and 0 parts whose output grew

the publication differential proves the contract the decision asked for: 19,896 pristine member rows, 0 of which stopped being byte-identical to their source, and exactly 4 regenerated members that change, all ppt/presentation.xml on the one writer that publishes codec output, all canonically equal with identical node counts

the public-read differential over 179,205 observations per leg finds 0 changed values, 0 canonical differences, and 4 outcome changes that are all a pre-existing litchi-docx defect change 0588 reported being fixed

the migration also removed a second pre-existing defect the change surfaced: litchi-xlsx's print-options parser refused its own preprocessor's output, so every worksheet whose printOptions sat inside an mc:AlternateContent was unreadable

change 0664's marker-bearing selectors, landed after this change's own measurement window, price the codec branch directly and agree: pptx_marker_ordinary_save_edit falls 155,537,122 -> 21,340,230 ns (-86.28%, A/A 2.96%) and its marker/control ratio falls from 20.79x to 2.94x, while every byte-identical control selector moves less than its own floor

the cumulative namespace-binding limit change 0664 found (MAX_SEMANTIC_TEXT_NAMESPACE_BINDINGS, 4096) stops refusing a marker-bearing DOCX with the limit itself untouched: the marker corpus goes from 'semantic DOCX XML exceeds 4096 namespace bindings' to the control's exact projection, 2,689 bytes over 200 objects

accepted_evidence.corpus_identity: 320 fixtures, 6,964 .xml/.rels parts, both legs, compared on a namespace-resolving projection with declarations excluded, the complete Report, the borrow decision, the refusal identity and the output length
accepted_evidence.adversarial: change 0588's mutation differential unchanged: 9 MCE-bearing seeds, 30,000 single- to triple-byte mutants, 16,661 refusals, 0 mismatches
accepted_evidence.publication: twelve documented save routes over all 320 fixtures on both legs, 20,421 published member rows per leg, compared against the source member and against the other leg, with a namespace-resolving canonicalizer on every differing member
accepted_evidence.public_reads: every documented public read of litchi-docx, litchi-pptx and litchi-xlsx over the same corpus, 179,205 observation lines per leg, classified into value changes, outcome changes, canonically-equal markup changes and canonically-different markup changes
accepted_evidence.instructions: callgrind isolation pairs (1 rep against 6, differenced and divided by 5) for the codec, plus whole-process eager and source-backed reads, on the real fixture and change 0587's marker-stripped control
accepted_evidence.timing_xlsx: 80 samples per leg, order A1 B1 B2 A2, four scenarios, with two further before-leg blocks as the A/A floor in the same window
accepted_evidence.timing_deck: change 0649's probe on its real deck and a marker-stripped control, 30 samples per block, four blocks per leg plus two A/A blocks
accepted_evidence.harness: tools/perf-baseline ABBA: change 0588's four marker-free XLSX selectors over three corpus shapes each as the no-regression leg, and change 0638's three real-file PPTX ordinary-save rows on the 0649 deck
accepted_evidence.marker_selectors: change 0664's marker/control families for DOCX and PPTX, seven pairs, 30 samples per block, ABBA plus two A/A blocks, built from a fresh checkout of the base and from this worktree with 0664's tools-only diff applied and reverted
accepted_evidence.text_sink_witness: a retained pair reproducing change 0664's DOCX text-sink refusal at the smallest size that shows it: a 33-declaration root with 200 paragraphs, marker and byte-length-identical inert control, through Document::write_text_to on both legs

accepted_costs.published_bytes_change: the bytes returned by every retained-markup accessor and by the one writer that publishes codec output change; no namespace-resolving meaning changes, and the change is measured at 13,250,784 -> 1,615,294 bytes over 2,209 read observations and 1,382,758 -> 1,347,127 uncompressed bytes over the four affected published parts
accepted_costs.refusals_that_disappear: an input whose only refusal was manufactured by the writer's own expansion is now admitted: LimitExceeded("output bytes") where the part fits its bound, and litchi-xlsx's unknown printOptions attribute 'xmlns'. The bounds did not move; the bytes did
accepted_costs.one_owned_copy_in_pptx: litchi-pptx's picture-descriptor read now allocates one owned copy per descriptor (590 bytes on the fixture) where it borrowed; still a net reduction, and the borrowed alternative is a larger change than this migration is scoped to
accepted_costs.counting_publish_regression: pptx_real_file_ordinary_save_counting_publish is +20.81% in the ABBA and +13.2% in isolation, against A/A block spreads of 20% and 36%; the published bytes are identical and the per-sample work fell 83%, so the argued mechanism is allocator heap state, argued and not demonstrated
accepted_costs.slice_boundary_cost: a consumer that parses a span standalone now pays a bounded scan of the bytes before it, with two fast paths for the shape every real producer writes; it is not separately measured

known_gaps.eager_xlsx_wall_clock: it took three windows: the first two were destroyed by unpinned neighbours (A/A spreads of 316.99% and 622.68% at load average 25 to 45) and are retained as failures; only the third, measured at load average 9.5 with a 2.17% floor over twelve before blocks, is quoted
known_gaps.six_xlsx_accessors_uncovered: the read differential found zero markup observations for sheetView ext, sheetViews-collection ext, pivotArea, ignoredErrors ext, named-sheet-view ext and calculation-chain extLst, and none for an inline conditional-formatting dxf; their migration rests on the unit tests added beside them
known_gaps.pptx_source_backed_pictures_uncovered: SourceBackedPresentation::images() reached zero MCE-rewritten slides in the corpus, because that reader refuses them up front identically on both legs
known_gaps.xlsb_writer_unexercised: litchi-xlsb's drawing-anchor transfer is the second writer that publishes codec output and has no fixture in an OOXML corpus; its code is unchanged and it already re-injects the source root's declarations explicitly
known_gaps.guides_writer_narrow: the one exercised publishing writer runs on 4 of 78 PPTX fixtures, because it refuses the other 74 as not compact before publication
known_gaps.stale_admission_prose: litchi-xlsx's raw/worksheet/mod.rs documents MceRewriteEquivalence and MAX_REWRITTEN_DECLARATIONS in terms of the old writer. The predicate stays sound and conservative, but its prose is wrong and its bound is now much looser than it needs to be. That file belongs to change 0657 in this wave, so it is reported and not edited
known_gaps.three_unmigrated_slicing_sites: litchi-xlsx's query_table extension-list retention, auto_filter capture and data_validation collection capture also slice the processed buffer; change 0588 did not name them and this change does not migrate them
known_gaps.process_content_prefix_refusal: an element unwrapped by mc:ProcessContent still cannot declare a prefixed namespace; pre-existing, still pinned by a test, and fixing it would move a refusal
known_gaps.allocations_and_rss: no allocation-count, RSS, cold-cache, physical-I/O, throughput, concurrency or cross-platform measurement was taken

withheld: any registered speedup, throughput, cold-cache, physical-I/O, concurrency-scaling or cross-platform result
any wall-clock result for the eager XLSX read on the real fixture
any claim that the six unwitnessed XLSX accessors or the PPTX source-backed picture path behave correctly on a real producer file
